warehouse/30169.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Marty: Do you have an item too heavy to carry around, but too valuable simply to abandon? Why not make use of our warehouse? We Dwarves have branches throughout the entire continent. When you deposit an item with us, you can retrieve it from anywhere! In fact, we even have a branch…

warehouse/30169-noteach.htm.text: Warehouse Keeper Marty: I think you've come to the wrong place, friend. A Warehouse Keeper can teach Scavengers and Hunters, but that's it. Perhaps there's someone else here better suited for your profession?
